description.value:
奇物，非普通（需同調）
這副工匠護目鏡有3發充能。以一個動作，你可以消耗一發充能並從目鏡中向一個位於你120尺內生物射出一道烈焰光線。目標必須成功通過一次[[/save ability=dex dc=15]]豁免否則受到[[/damage 3d6 type=fire]]傷害。目鏡在每日黎明恢復[[/r 1d3]]發已消耗的充能。
詛咒Cursed。目鏡被詛咒了，而與目鏡同調會令你也被詛咒。你無法摘下目鏡，直到同調結束或者你被法術@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.ewDH2w8w2yLSM021]{移除詛咒 Remove Curse}或類似魔法指定爲目標。
每當你使用目鏡的烈焰光線且目標用於此豁免的d20骰出了[[/r d20]]時，目鏡都會令你被強烈閃光&Reference[rule=brightlight]{bright light}刺目。你陷入目盲狀態，持續24小時。

These tinker's goggles have 3 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to shoot a beam of fiery light from the goggles at a creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw or take [[/damage 3d6 type=fire]] damage. The goggles regain [[/r 1d3]] expended charges daily at dawn.

Cursed. The goggles are cursed, and becoming attuned to them extends the curse to you. You can't remove the goggles or end your attunement to them until you are targeted by a @spell[Remove Curse] spell or similar magic.

Whenever you use the goggles' fiery beam and the target rolls a 20 on the [[/r d20]] for the saving throw, the goggles expose you to a flash of violent &Reference[rule=brightlight]{bright light}. As a result, you have the blinded condition for 24 hours.
